title: GLM-4.5
before: Open agentic models came mainly from DeepSeek, Qwen and Moonshot.
problem: Reasoning, coding and agentic skill were usually strong in one model and weak in the others.
breakthrough: An open MoE explicitly targeting all three together, released under MIT.
why: It widened the open frontier to a fourth serious lab and pushed the unified-capability framing.
inherits: Open models competing on agentic benchmarks, not just knowledge.
